english.title: Possess ammunition with intent to endanger life / enable another to do so
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) had in your possession ammunition

(A)_[with intent]_
(B)_[to enable another person]_
(C)_[with intent by means thereof to endanger life or to enable another person]_

by means thereof to endanger life
english.legislation: Contrary to section 16 of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.

english.notes:
(i) For conspiracy to commit this offence see H101367. See also offence wordings: H2212, H2218 and H2224.
(ii) An offence of 'possessing a firearm to create the fear of violence' was created by the Firearms (Amendment) Act 1994. It has a wider scope than the above and should be considered where this offence is not suitable - see H1162, H1163 and H1164.
(iii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).
(iv) This offence is a specified violent offence under section 306 of the Sentencing Act 2020, see Part 1 of Schedule 18 to that Act; this is, for example, relevant for certain extended sentences of detention or imprisonment.
(v) Where an offender has already been convicted for this offence and commits a further specified offence, an extended sentence may be available, see sections 267 and 280 of, and Schedule 14 to, the Sentencing Act 2020.
(vi) This offence is also an index offence and previous offence under section 273 of the Sentencing Act 2020 when a court decides on imposing custody for life for a second listed offence under section 272 or a life sentence as provided for in section 283, see Schedule 15 to that Act.
(vii) This offence is also a Schedule 19 offence under section 307 of, and Schedule 19 to, the Sentencing Act 2020 carrying a maximum of imprisonment for life, see sections 258, 274 and 285 of that Act for required sentences of detention/custody for life.

other.penalty:
Indictment: maximum life imprisonment and/or a fine.

A minimum sentence may apply to this offence, see section 311 of, and Schedule 20 to, the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
